scope: Day 1 design, document and schema checks only
schema_check_runtime: Host Python 3.13.9 and already-installed jsonschema; no project dependencies installed
case_coverage: intent valid, unicode, size boundary, empty, blank, missing, extra, nonstring, oversize and scalar
read, append, maintenance and mixed-tool valid plan shapes
risk enum, blank/oversize/missing goal, extra plan fields, empty/excess/string steps
unknown tool, wrong/missing version, extra step/argument, missing service_id

captured_live_plan: REJECTED_BY_SCHEMA; direct inference responded, but this was not a valid plan or repository integration test

credential_pattern_scan: NO MATCHES in README, docs and schemas; bounded heuristic scan, not a comprehensive security audit
application_runtime_tests: NOT RUN: no implementation or existing product suite
